title: Microphone & Voice Capture Management
description: Configure node microphones, VAD sensitivity threshold, AI neural noise cancellation (RNNoise), and live VU-meter testing
vad_desc: Sets the minimum voice amplitude required to trigger speech recognition over ambient noise
rnnoise_desc: Embedded deep learning filter isolating speech from steady background noises (fans, traffic, vacuum)
aec_desc: Prevents microphone feedback when assistant audio plays through node speakers
agc_desc: Dynamically balances input level to keep speech clear at varying distances
test_desc: Speak into the microphone to verify wave amplitude and voice clarity
